title: BREAKING: Trianna Elaine Barrera Arrested on Felony Drug and Evidence-Tampering Charges
excerpt: Trianna Elaine Barrera was arrested October 26, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department on two third-degree felony charges, drug possession and tampering with evidence, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Trianna Elaine Barrera was arrested on October 26, 2026, at 1:12 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Barrera is charged with possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 2, between 1 and 4 grams, a third-degree felony, and tampering with or fabricating physical evidence with intent to impair, a third-degree felony. The charges are allegations, and Barrera is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amounts were listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
